bio: Trendy, hip and relaxed is how you might describe this pleasant restaurant right on the waterfront. Great view of the container port – especially from the terrace in summer. The kitchen serves modern seafood, e.g. Tristan Rock Lobster, Bisque, Papaya, Mousseline. Some dishes are also ideal for sharing. Vegetarian and vegan dishes are also available. In addition to the a la carte selection, the restaurant offers a tasting menu with six or seven courses....
